description: Publishes a complete DMARC record with aggregate (rua) and failure (ruf) reporting addresses. Because DNS holds one DMARC record per name, applying this REPLACES any existing record beginning v=DMARC1 at _dmarc. Signet offers it only where the domain has no DMARC record, and reads _dmarc again immediately before sending the customer to apply it.
variableDescription: %policy%: none, quarantine or reject; %rua%: comma-separated mailto: URIs for aggregate reports; %ruf%: comma-separated mailto: URIs for failure reports
